summary_en: The company raised its fiscal year ending March 2027 year-end dividend forecast by 2 yen to 27 yen per share, reflecting a balanced approach between dividend enhancement and retained earnings retention.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of dividend forecast (increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the board of directors of Toho Chemical Industry resolved to revise the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 year-end dividend forecast. The year-end dividend per share has been increased by 2 yen from the previous forecast of 25 yen to 27 yen, resulting in an annual dividend of 27 yen per share.

The company stated that its fundamental dividend policy is to balance the enhancement of dividends with the prioritization of retained earnings. Based on a comprehensive assessment of business performance trends and financial conditions, the company determined this dividend increase was appropriate. The company's dividend payment record shows no interim dividend in the current fiscal year, with the full dividend amount distributed at the fiscal year-end. In the previous fiscal year ended March 2026, the annual dividend was 22 yen per share.
